channel.description: Evidence-based longevity science for women 35+: what the research actually shows about sleep, strength, skin, hormones and supplements.

item.title: Rosemary oil for hair growth: what the one trial really found
item.description: Does rosemary oil regrow hair? The one randomized trial studied men, not women. What it found, what's missing, and what to know about skin reactions.

item.title: Hair loss in women: the most common causes and how to tell them apart
item.description: Thinning, shedding or bald patches? The main causes of hair loss in women, how each one looks, and what to ask a dermatologist to check.

item.title: Strength training for bone density around menopause: what the trials show
item.description: Can lifting weights protect bone density around menopause? What trials like LIFTMOR found, who was studied, safety, and when to ask about a DEXA scan.

item.title: Urolithin A: what the human trials actually show
item.description: Does urolithin A help muscle and mitochondria? What the human trials found, who was studied, the doses tested and what is still animal-only.

item.title: VO2 max for women: why it matters and how to raise it
item.description: What VO2 max is, how it changes with age in women, what the mortality research shows, and what trials in women found raises it.

item.title: Red light therapy for skin over 40: what the evidence shows
item.description: Do LED masks smooth wrinkles after 40? What the studies behind red light therapy found, what FDA clearance means, and how to use a mask safely.

item.title: Creatine for women over 40: what the research actually shows
item.description: Does creatine help women over 40 with muscle, bone or brain? What the human trials found, the doses they tested, and the honest bottom line.

item.title: Menopause brings abrupt changes in bone, liver and blood fats, huge study finds
item.description: A Nature Medicine study of 300 million lab tests from over a million women found a sudden shift at the final period, with hormones changing 12-15 years earlier.
